src: red and green marker pixels inside cells of the teal lattice
path: straight horizontal or vertical lattice-cell run from a marker cell to a same-color marker cell sharing its lattice row or column
dst: the aligned same-color marker cell at the other end of the run
trajectory: fill every whole lattice cell on the inclusive run with the marker color
transform: preserve the teal lattice; cells covered by both red and green runs become pink
